Ar-Rahman is one of Allah's names. It means the Most Kind.
He taught the Quran.
He made man.
And He taught him to speak clearly.
The sun and the moon move by a plan.
The stars and the trees bow down to Allah.
He lifted up the sky and set up the scale.
So do not cheat when you weigh things.
Weigh things fairly and do not make the scale short.
He set the earth for all living things.
In it are fruits and date trees with big bunches.
And grain with its leaves, and sweet-smelling plants.
So which of your Lord's gifts will you say no to?
He made man from dry clay, like pottery.
And He made the jinn from a flame of fire.
So which of your Lord's gifts will you say no to?
He is the Lord of the two places where the sun comes up and the two places where it goes down.
So which of your Lord's gifts will you say no to?
He let the two seas meet together.
Between them is a wall that they do not cross.
So which of your Lord's gifts will you say no to?
Pearls and coral come out from them.
So which of your Lord's gifts will you say no to?
His are the ships that stand tall on the sea like mountains.
So which of your Lord's gifts will you say no to?
Everyone on the earth will pass away.
Only the Face of your Lord will stay, full of greatness and honor.
So which of your Lord's gifts will you say no to?
Everyone in the sky and the earth asks Him for what they need. Every day He is busy with something.
So which of your Lord's gifts will you say no to?
We will soon take care of you, O two groups, people and jinn.
So which of your Lord's gifts will you say no to?
O jinn and people! If you can go beyond the edges of the sky and the earth, go! But you cannot go without Allah's power.
So which of your Lord's gifts will you say no to?
Flames of fire and hot smoke will be sent at you, and you will not win.
So which of your Lord's gifts will you say no to?
When the sky splits open and turns red like paint.
So which of your Lord's gifts will you say no to?
On that Day no person and no jinn will need to be asked about their sins.
So which of your Lord's gifts will you say no to?
The people who did wrong will be known by their marks. They will be taken by their heads and feet.
So which of your Lord's gifts will you say no to?
This is Hell that the people who did wrong said was a lie.
They go around between it and boiling water.
So which of your Lord's gifts will you say no to?
But for the one who feared standing before his Lord, there are two gardens.
So which of your Lord's gifts will you say no to?
Full of many kinds of good things.
So which of your Lord's gifts will you say no to?
In them are two flowing springs.
So which of your Lord's gifts will you say no to?
In them are two kinds of every fruit.
So which of your Lord's gifts will you say no to?
They rest on rich beds. The fruit of the two gardens is close enough to reach.
So which of your Lord's gifts will you say no to?
In them are shy and modest companions. No person and no jinn has touched them before.
So which of your Lord's gifts will you say no to?
They are like rubies and coral.
So which of your Lord's gifts will you say no to?
Is the reward for good anything but good?
So which of your Lord's gifts will you say no to?
And below those are two more gardens.
So which of your Lord's gifts will you say no to?
Deep green.
So which of your Lord's gifts will you say no to?
In them are two springs pouring out water.
So which of your Lord's gifts will you say no to?
In them are fruits, date trees and pomegranates.
So which of your Lord's gifts will you say no to?
In them are good and beautiful ones.
So which of your Lord's gifts will you say no to?
Companions kept in tents.
So which of your Lord's gifts will you say no to?
No person and no jinn has touched them before.
So which of your Lord's gifts will you say no to?
They rest on green cushions and beautiful carpets.
So which of your Lord's gifts will you say no to?
Blessed is the name of your Lord, full of greatness and honor.
